reports.title: Campus Computing Decarbonization & Circular Recovery Report
reports.executiveSummary: In October 2024, the institution achieved its lowest monthly computer lab electricity consumption of the academic year, recording a total reduction of 5,840 kWh across 8 academic departments. Sustained implementation of automated shutdown policies after 7:00 PM and student device eco-mode adoption drove a 16.4% reduction in peak load. E-waste collection exceeded targets by 22%, driven by the pre-Diwali electronics amnesty drive.

topPerforming.keyAction: Piloted automatic WOL (Wake-on-LAN) scheduler cutting standby draw.
Refurbished 45 lab PCs and diverted 240kg of e-waste.
Implemented sleep triggers in VLSI lab workstations.

needsImprovement.issue: GIS workstations left running rendering jobs overnight with unoptimized sleep timers.
Bloomberg terminals maintained on active standby during weekends.

keyAchievements: Eliminated 100% of weekend idle vampire load in IT Lab GH-202 through central smart relays.
Over 1,280 students completed the GreenCampus Personal Footprint Calculator, pledging 6,200 kg CO2 reductions.
Partnered with R2-certified recycler to safely recover 135 grams of gold and 578 kg of high-purity copper from campus e-waste.
Zero computer equipment dispatched to municipal landfills.
recommendations: Roll out automated script-based power down for CAD and GIS rendering machines across Mechanical and Civil departments.
Extend the 4-year workstation refresh cycle to 5 years via selective NVMe and RAM upgrades, saving an estimated 14,000 kg CO2 in embodied manufacturing emissions.
Install 2 additional smart e-waste drop-off bins at the new Research Park building entrance.
Provide solar-powered laptop charging stations at the Central Lawn study gazebos.

sdg12.title: SDG 12: Responsible Consumption and Production
sdg12.statement: Aligned with Target 12.5 (substantially reduce waste generation through prevention, reduction, recycling, and reuse).

sdg13.title: SDG 13: Climate Action
sdg13.statement: Directly supports Target 13.3 (improve education, awareness-raising, and human and institutional capacity on climate change mitigation).

reports.title: Autumn Energy Benchmarking & Lab Optimization Report
reports.executiveSummary: September 2024 saw the return of peak academic laboratory utilization. Despite an 18% increase in lab student hours, electricity consumption grew by only 3.2% due to strict monitor sleep timeouts and department-level energy accountability dashboards.

topPerforming.keyAction: Virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) migration for 30 PCs.

keyAchievements: Completed 100% LED retrofit in all 14 computing labs.
Inaugurated the GreenTech Student Society with 200 initial members.
recommendations: Audit server room air conditioning temperature set points (+2°C adjustment recommended).
Introduce student printing quota linked to carbon impact.

sdg12.title: SDG 12: Responsible Consumption and Production
sdg12.statement: Expanding equipment repurposing across non-technical campus departments.

sdg13.title: SDG 13: Climate Action
sdg13.statement: Decoupling academic lab hours from carbon emission growth.

reports.title: Semester Kick-off Sustainability Baseline Report
reports.executiveSummary: At the start of the Autumn term, campus energy audits established a new computing baseline of 28,500 kWh/month across all academic blocks. A student induction module on sustainable computing reached 1,400 freshmen.

topPerforming.keyAction: Smart sub-metering installed in all labs.

keyAchievements: 1,400 new freshmen onboarded to GreenCampus mobile/web portal.
Launched the campus battery recycling collection point.
recommendations: Schedule department-wide e-waste drive prior to mid-term examinations.

sdg12.title: SDG 12: Responsible Consumption and Production
sdg12.statement: Safe disposal and zero toxic landfill seepage from campus batteries.

sdg13.statement: Institutional climate pledge integration into student curriculum.
